integrity: The minimal boundary is reproduced by a complete anonymous census through five voters and an independent direct enumeration of all 7776 labeled five-voter profiles, with two separate Baldwin winner implementations required to agree.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for three candidates, strict complete ballots, one unilateral manipulator, and tie-independent unique Baldwin outcomes. Fixed tie-breaking and larger candidate sets are outside scope.
title: Sharp five-voter manipulation boundary for three-candidate Baldwin voting
